name: eth_call
summary: Executes a new message call (locally) immediately without creating a transaction on the block chain.
description:
Executes a new message call (locally) immediately without creating a transaction on the block chain.

The `gas` value is read as an unsigned integer. If it is omitted, it defaults to 100000000000000. Any value above the `rpc.callGasCap` node setting (10000000 by default) is reduced to that cap. Setting the cap to 0 disables it, in which case a value above 2^63 - 1 is reduced to 2^63 - 1.

result.name: returnValue
result.description: The return value of the executed contract
